title: I love Gonesh incense
text: I love Gonesh incense. I love Gonesh incense, I truly do. I usually get these at my local hot topic but i did not have time to do so, so I decided to order them. Don't believe the Prime shipping on this product. I did not get it when I was supposed to get it and that is why I gave this a 3-star rating. This will teach me from trying to be lazy.
